Job description

We are looking for a highly experienced and skilled Chief Marketing Officer to lead our marketing efforts in Mumbai. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in marketing and a proven track record of success.


Roles and Responsibility



  • Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies to achieve business objectives.

  • Lead cross-functional teams to launch new products and services.

  • Conduct market research and analyze consumer trends to identify opportunities.

  • Manage and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including customers and partners.

  • Collaborate with the sales team to drive revenue growth.

  • Monitor and report on marketing performance metrics.


Job Requirements



  • Proven experience in marketing leadership roles, preferably in the hospitality industry.

  • Strong understanding of marketing principles and practices.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Experience with marketing automation tools and data analysis software.


About Company


Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd. is a leading hotel management company committed to delivering exceptional guest experiences and driving business success. We are a team of dedicated professionals passionate about hospitality and eager to make a positive impact in our communities.
